page.main:
Python

Use Python to read local data, build queries, and inspect or export results. Admitted queries run in ShardLoom. Unsupported work returns a diagnostic without fallback execution.

Run a local query
Section titled “Run a local query”

Create the small CSV in the getting-started walkthrough before running this example. The public run() report exposes the result and native execution evidence.

import shardloom as sl


ctx = sl.context()
result = (
    ctx.read("data/orders.csv")
       .filter(sl.col("status") == "paid")
       .limit(10)
       .run()
)


print(result.envelope.field_int("output_row_count"))
print(result.envelope.human_text)
print(result.fallback_attempted, result.external_engine_invoked)

ctx.read(path) infers local adapters for .csv, .json, .jsonl, .ndjson, .parquet, .arrow, .ipc, .feather, .avro, .orc, and .vortex. CSV, flat JSON/JSONL/NDJSON, generated rows, and scoped local Vortex inputs are the default public examples. Parquet, Arrow IPC/Feather, Avro, and ORC are scoped local-format surfaces when the matching feature-gated build is present; otherwise ShardLoom returns deterministic adapter blockers without fallback execution.

Reuse And Export
Section titled “Reuse And Export”

Python contexts can retain a local worker to avoid per-call CLI startup. Automatic preparation reuses an unchanged source only when its schema and artifact identities match. Each query still has fresh execution state; a prepared artifact is not a cache of query results.

Admitted flat results can use write_vortex, write_parquet, write_arrow_ipc, write_avro, write_orc, write_csv, write_json, and write_jsonl through the shared native result and sink contracts. Feature gates, supported types, and result limits apply. See runtime and I/O and the user-surface index.

Section titled “Consume results in batches”

The separately approved v0.5.0 train follows current PR/docs closeout and a full fresh UAT run before the version bump.

The packet contains 53,641,616 compressed bytes with SHA-256 e7107caebc9f374672e6a5d755feb53b521796233a2eab7ff52ce4ac71ef901a. Original hashes identify local bytes; portable text substitutes local paths. The finalizer reconstructs and reopens complete values before a separate stream inspector checks packaged coverage, claims and raw no-fallback reports.

Contract and reuse

The design and reuse map records the Vortex-first decision. Pinned Vortex 0.85.0 supplies typed arrays, builders, native take, Flat file writing and bounded row-range reads. ShardLoom retains online pivot semantics, exact key comparison, admission, cancellation, disk quota, cleanup and publication. No dependency or external engine is added.

A bounded sparse buffer flushes complete latest cell states into immutable native runs. A later update resolves the newest exact state before applying the existing transition. Adjacent chronological merges retain the newer replacement; they do not reassociate floating partial totals. Index markers retain the first representative once. Charged key bounds, two credited payload slots and held generation checks bound lookups without a full resident index or dense matrix.

Completion preserves source-order limits, discovered domains and the existing column/grand-margin observation order. Bounded index-position batches gather selected values late. Shared cell transitions retain first/first-unique, nullable and nested extrema, floating-prefix checks and exact decimal totals. The shared native writer also drains accepted work before returning a producer or sink failure, retaining its first I/O error and preventing failed publication.

This remains the existing relational SQL/Python/DataFrame/CLI route and its admitted collection, incremental-result and representable writer consumers. It adds no aggregate, type, margin or field admission. Dynamic one-shot input needs a separate complete-plan admission contract before schema discovery can consume a producer. Spill alone does not provide that contract.

Complete constrained workload

One file-backed fixture contains 24,580 input rows with 6,145 distinct 768-byte string keys. Each key receives the ordered floating updates 1e16, 1, -1e16 and 3; the expected final value is 3. Both spill executions check every output value and canonical key order against that independent construction. The same fixture supplies the constrained-denial and ample-resident controls.

"""Bind hosted acceptance to the post-UAT reviewed pivot implementation."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
import subprocess

import pivot_post_uat_common as support

c = support.c
HEAD = '1675693e3820906bb1859e48d0cc57eec36f8603'
BASE = 'a88ec5c997e3da1633b9647a9e0e439681c8b467'
RUNTIME = '5665eee5b86a585ea50b7b54cbbd43f82154222f'
PREVIEW = 'https://825f00bc-shardloom.djheinrich.workers.dev'
REPORT = 'docs/benchmarks/native-pivot-pressure-2026-10-08.md'
GH = '/opt/homebrew/bin/gh'
REPO = 'depsilon/shardloom'
PR = 1534
BASELINE_PR = 1533
QUOTA_COMMENT = f'https://github.com/{REPO}/pull/{PR}#issuecomment-6080804057'
SPILL_LINK = 'https://github.com/depsilon/shardloom/blob/main/docs/reference/native-query-spill.md#sparse-pivot-state'
CODEQL_OLD_HEAD = '83cd67d663a241dbe11ffaf16113f9ecb4f1fe98'
CODEQL_FILE = 'shardloom-vortex/src/local_primitive_relational_pivot_spill_tests.rs'
CODEQL_THREADS = {
    'PRRT_kwDOSScs_c6qx7G-': {
        'url': f'https://github.com/{REPO}/pull/{PR}#discussion_r4230152523',
        'alert': 115, 'line': 160,
    },
    'PRRT_kwDOSScs_c6qx7HK': {
        'url': f'https://github.com/{REPO}/pull/{PR}#discussion_r4230152539',
        'alert': 116, 'line': 189,
    },
}
CODEQL_REVIEW_ID = 'PRR_kwDOSScs_c8AAAABRgsapA'


def run(*command):
    return subprocess.check_output(command, cwd=c.ROOT, text=True, timeout=60).strip()


def pr(number):
    return json.loads(run(GH, 'pr', 'view', str(number), '--repo', REPO, '--json',
        'number,url,state,isDraft,headRefOid,baseRefOid,mergeCommit,mergedAt,mergeStateStatus,statusCheckRollup,reviews,comments'))


def validate_codeql_comment(comment, expected):
    assert comment['url'] == expected['url']
    assert comment['author']['login'] == 'github-advanced-security'
    assert comment['originalCommit']['oid'] == CODEQL_OLD_HEAD
    assert comment['path'] == CODEQL_FILE and comment['originalLine'] == expected['line']
    assert comment['body'] == (
        '## CodeQL / Cleartext logging of sensitive information\n\n'
        'This operation writes [...::certify_json_delivery(...)](1) to a log file.\n\n'
        f'[Show more details](https://github.com/{REPO}/security/code-scanning/{expected["alert"]})')


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--stage', choices=('premerge', 'postmerge'), required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--attempt', type=int, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    assert args.attempt > 0
    prefix = f'pivot-hosted-{args.stage}-{args.attempt}'
    observed, baseline = pr(PR), pr(BASELINE_PR)
    query = f'''query {{ repository(owner: "depsilon", name: "shardloom") {{
      pullRequest(number: {PR}) {{
        reviewThreads(first: 100) {{ nodes {{ id isResolved isOutdated path originalLine
          comments(first: 100) {{ nodes {{ body url author {{ login }} originalCommit {{ oid }} path originalLine }}
            pageInfo {{ hasNextPage }} }} }} pageInfo {{ hasNextPage }} }}
        reviews(last: 100) {{ nodes {{ id state body submittedAt commit {{ oid }} author {{ login }} }}
          pageInfo {{ hasPreviousPage }} }}
        comments(last: 100) {{ nodes {{ id body url author {{ login }} }}
          pageInfo {{ hasPreviousPage }} }}
      }}
    }} }}'''
    reviews = json.loads(run(GH, 'api', 'graphql', '-f', 'query=' + query))
    runs = json.loads(run(GH, 'api', 'repos/' + REPO
        + '/actions/runs?event=pull_request&head_sha=' + HEAD + '&per_page=100'))
    head_check_runs = json.loads(run(GH, 'api', 'repos/' + REPO
        + '/commits/' + HEAD + '/check-runs?per_page=100'))
    snapshot = {'pr': observed, 'baseline_pr': baseline, 'reviews': reviews,
        'workflow_runs': runs, 'head_check_runs': head_check_runs,
        'observed_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    c.write(c.OUT / (prefix + '-snapshot.json'), snapshot)
    assert not c.git('status', '--porcelain'), 'requires the clean accepted tree'
    assert observed['headRefOid'] == HEAD and not observed['isDraft']
    assert baseline['state'] == 'MERGED' and baseline['mergeCommit']['oid'] == BASE
    expected = {row['name'] for row in baseline['statusCheckRollup']}
    assert len(expected) == 39
    for workflow in ('.github/workflows/ci.yml', '.github/workflows/codeql-analysis.yml'):
        assert c.git('show', BASE + ':' + workflow) == c.git('show', HEAD + ':' + workflow)
    checks = observed['statusCheckRollup']
    assert len(checks) == len(expected) and {row['name'] for row in checks} == expected
    assert all(row['status'] == 'COMPLETED' and row['conclusion'] == 'SUCCESS'
        for row in checks), [(row['name'], row['status'], row['conclusion'])
                            for row in checks if row['conclusion'] != 'SUCCESS']
    assert runs['total_count'] == len(runs['workflow_runs']) == 2
    assert {row['name'] for row in runs['workflow_runs']} == {'CI', 'CodeQL Analysis'}
    assert all(row['head_sha'] == HEAD and row['status'] == 'completed'
        and row['conclusion'] == 'success' for row in runs['workflow_runs'])
    assert head_check_runs['total_count'] == len(head_check_runs['check_runs'])
    preview_deployments = [row for row in head_check_runs['check_runs']
        if row['name'] == 'Workers Builds: shardloom']
    assert len(preview_deployments) == 1
    preview_deployment = preview_deployments[0]
    assert preview_deployment['head_sha'] == HEAD and preview_deployment['status'] == 'completed'
    assert preview_deployment['conclusion'] == 'success'
    preview_lines = [line.strip() for line in preview_deployment['output']['summary'].splitlines()
        if line.strip().startswith('Preview URL:')]
    assert preview_lines == ['Preview URL: ' + PREVIEW]
    codeql_runs = [row for row in head_check_runs['check_runs'] if row['name'] == 'CodeQL']
    assert len(codeql_runs) == 1
    codeql_run = codeql_runs[0]
    assert codeql_run['head_sha'] == HEAD and codeql_run['status'] == 'completed'
    assert codeql_run['conclusion'] == 'success'
    assert 'errors' not in reviews
    review = reviews['data']['repository']['pullRequest']
    assert not review['reviewThreads']['pageInfo']['hasNextPage']
    assert not review['reviews']['pageInfo']['hasPreviousPage']
    assert not review['comments']['pageInfo']['hasPreviousPage']
    threads = review['reviewThreads']['nodes']
    assert {thread['id'] for thread in threads} == set(CODEQL_THREADS)
    for thread in threads:
        expected_thread = CODEQL_THREADS[thread['id']]
        assert thread['isOutdated'] is True
        assert thread['path'] == CODEQL_FILE and thread['originalLine'] == expected_thread['line']
        assert not thread['comments']['pageInfo']['hasNextPage']
        comments_in_thread = thread['comments']['nodes']
        assert len(comments_in_thread) == 1
        validate_codeql_comment(comments_in_thread[0], expected_thread)
    submitted_reviews = review['reviews']['nodes']
    assert len(submitted_reviews) == 1
    previous_codeql_review, = submitted_reviews
    assert previous_codeql_review['id'] == CODEQL_REVIEW_ID
    assert previous_codeql_review['author']['login'] == 'github-advanced-security'
    assert previous_codeql_review['state'] == 'COMMENTED' and previous_codeql_review['body'] == ''
    assert previous_codeql_review['commit']['oid'] == CODEQL_OLD_HEAD
    comments = review['comments']['nodes']
    quota = [row for row in comments
        if row['author']['login'] == 'chatgpt-codex-connector'
        and row['url'] == QUOTA_COMMENT
        and row['body'].startswith('You have reached your Codex usage limits for code reviews.')]
    assert len(quota) == 1, 'changed automated-review state requires primary inspection'
    assert not any('<!-- codex-pull-request-review-summary -->' in row['body'] for row in comments)
    cloudflare = [row for row in comments if row['author']['login'] == 'cloudflare-workers-and-pages']
